name: Tooltips live in a TooltipArea wrapper, not in the application
body:
# Tooltips live in a TooltipArea wrapper, not in the application

Dean (2026-11-05) moved IconButton's tooltip state into the component (`apps/world-editor/src/ui/IconButton.chaos`, caf3eb9) as an example of how components should be written: a component's functions stay with it, and `EditorApplication` doesn't collect behaviour that doesn't belong to it. That broke the tooltip, because the delay and the drawing still live in `EditorApplication` (`ShowTooltip`, `HideTooltip`, `PollTooltip` and five tooltip fields) and `App.chaos`.

It needs Chaos components to take children (Chaos board: "A component can't take children, so a wrapper component can't share behaviour"). One-at-a-time and dismiss-on-menu need context ("Components have no context, so app-wide services are reached through the application").
plan:
1. `TooltipArea` component (`src/ui/TooltipArea.chaos`): props `text` and `children`, `@signal` locals for the pending text, timer and position, an `OnTick` local for the 0.45 s delay, and its own conditional `<portal>` for the tooltip.
2. `IconButton`, `AssetCard` and `InspectorField`'s remove button wrap themselves in it.
3. Remove the tooltip fields and methods from `EditorApplication`, and `Tooltip.chaos` plus its slot from `App.chaos`.
4. Once Chaos has context, a small tooltip service keeps one tooltip at a time and lets menus hide it.
acceptance_criteria: Hovering a toolbar button, an asset card or the remove-property button shows the tooltip after the delay, and leaving hides it.
EditorApplication has no tooltip state or methods.
definition_of_done: Screenshot of a tooltip in the chat
